context: 6 Conclusion and Future Work In all instances of the problem considered in this paper, a proper ordering has played an important role. However we do not know a dichotomy classification for the instances of the problem that admit a PTAS. We ask for a dichotomy of the following form: If H belongs to class X of bipartite graphs then there is a PTAS for Max-Min allocation problem otherwise there is no PTAS. Acknowledgments. We would like to thank Monaldo Mastrolilli for many useful discussions and for proposing this problem to us.
